data.message: A two-sample or ANOVA test observed fewer than the required number of distinct groups in the SplitBy field. On a grouped request it is also raised at predict and runtime when SplitBy names a grouper field (details.reason split_is_grouper: every group holds one level) or a post-test's SplitBy names one of its partition key columns (details.reason split_is_partition_key: every partition holds one level), and it rides a warning naming details.group_key when one group is too sparse (that group's statistic and p_value are null; the others proceed).

fixups.hint: Pick a SplitBy field that resolves to >= 2 distinct categories after filtering, or relax upstream filters.
split_is_grouper: a grouped request runs the test once per group; drop the SplitBy field from groups, or run the across-groups test as its own ungrouped request.

split_is_partition_key: a post-test runs once per partition (every key but the last by default); pass partition_by [] to compare across the partition keys in one run, or reorder Request.Groups so the split key comes last.
